allow_rules.reason: Modules\Domain and Plugin\Domain extend Illuminate\Support\Collection (ModuleCollection, PluginCollection); both are published classes, so removing the dependency changes the public contract. To lift at the next major.

The application layer of Modules, Plugin and Theme still builds Infrastructure services directly (registrars, managers, discovery orchestrator), and the module named Application is read as a layer. Route, Schedule and VersionCheck are fixed; the rest needs ports, one module at a time.
